name: Viral Whole-Cucumber Salad
desc: A whole cucumber sliced thin into a deli container and shaken with soy, rice vinegar, sesame oil, MSG and chili crisp.

source.title: Viral Whole-Cucumber Salad
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

steps: Slice the cucumber very thin, ideally on a mandoline, straight into a quart deli container.
Add the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, MSG, chili crisp and peanut butter if using.
Put the lid on and shake hard until every slice is coated. Eat right away for the crunchiest cucumbers, or chill 1 to 2 hours for a quick-pickle texture.
tips: MSG plus chili crisp is what makes it taste like takeout.
The reel shows the ingredients without amounts. These follow published versions of the viral cucumber salad, so taste and adjust.

references.title: TikTok Cucumber Guy Recipe
